get.description:
Returns the Project users the requesting user is permitted to assign to an Observation. Call this before setting `observation[assignee_id]` (Assignee is a single-select) or `observation[assignee_ids]` (Assignee is a multi-select) — assigning a user absent from this list is rejected with a `403`.

The list narrows based on the requesting user's own permissions: users who cannot assign standard-level members see only Observations admins.

parameters.name: filters[category_id]
parameters.description: ID of the Observation Category used to narrow the returned users to those eligible to be assigned an Observation in that category.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: User ID of a person the requesting user is allowed to assign to an Observation. When Assignee is a single-select, pass as `observation[assignee_id]`. When Assignee is a multi-select, pass inside `observation[assignee_ids]`.

vendor.description: Company the user belongs to in this Procore company directory. Null when the user is not associated with a vendor. Use `vendor.id` with `filters[assignee_company_id]` to list Observations assigned to that company.

id.description: Vendor ID of the user's company.

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/observations/assignees?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bcategory_id%5D=1", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.summary: Filter observations assignees endpoint by Observation Category
x-changelog.description:
Updated the observations assignees endpoint to accept an optional `filters[category_id]` parameter. Where
advanced Observations permissions are in use, the endpoint now returns only the users who can be assigned
an Observation in that category. When the parameter is omitted, it returns the users who can be assigned
in at least one category the logged-in user can create an Observation in.

x-changelog.summary: Update observations assignees endpoint to support granular permissions
x-changelog.description:
Updated the observations assignees endpoint to return users based on granular permissions. The endpoint now respects
"Can be Assigned as Observation Assignee" and "Assign Observations to Users in the Same Company" granular
permissions, allowing read-only users with the appropriate granular permissions to be included in the
assignable users list.

parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.
